entities.summary: Daniel Joseph Godfread is an American retired professional basketball player at the center position with the Minnesota Timberwolves in the 1990–91 NBA season and the Houston Rockets in the 1991–92 NBA season. He also played in the Continental Basketball Association for the Rockford Lightning.
